body.message:
Please note that your new extension period will be from 28th September to 28th October, which is counted as 30 nights.

You may continue staying in Unit 112 until 2nd October. After that, we will move you to the next unit, where you can stay from 2nd October until 28th October, completing the extension period.

To clarify, your original check-out date is 28th September. The stay beyond this date is covered under your new extension booking.
